representation_notes.base_orientation_target: MuJoCo wxyz hand-base target quaternion, shape [4]
representation_notes.finger_actuator_targets: MuJoCo actuator targets ordered by finger_target_names

actuator_controls.coordinate_frame: MuJoCo actuator order recorded by actuator names
actuator_controls.normalization: Scale per actuator using control limits before learning.

base_orientation.normalization: Convert to a continuous rotation representation before learning.

base_position.normalization: Center on workspace neutral and scale by workspace range.

finger_joint_positions.normalization: Scale each named joint by its configured joint range.

finger_joint_velocities.normalization: Normalize each named joint velocity with training-set statistics.

object_state.absence_rule: object_states.npy is omitted when the task has no objects.
object_state.normalization: Normalize named object fields with training-set statistics.

robot_qpos.coordinate_frame: MuJoCo model coordinates; free-joint pose is in world frame
robot_qpos.normalization: Normalize each named degree of freedom with training-set statistics.
robot_qpos.units: MuJoCo generalized-position units: metres, unit quaternion, or radians

robot_qvel.normalization: Normalize each named degree of freedom with training-set statistics.
robot_qvel.units: MuJoCo generalized-velocity units: metres/second or radians/second

success_metric_inputs.absence_rule: task_states.npy is omitted when the task has no recomputable success metric.
success_metric_inputs.normalization: Preserve raw relabeling inputs; normalize only policy copies.
success_metric_inputs.units: task-defined SI units and unitless flags

target_state.absence_rule: task_states.npy is omitted when the task has no target state.
target_state.normalization: Normalize named target fields with training-set statistics.

task_state.absence_rule: task_states.npy is omitted when the task has no task state.
task_state.normalization: Normalize continuous task fields; keep flags categorical.
task_state.units: task-defined SI units and unitless flags

tracking_quality.normalization: Keep flags/codes categorical and confidence values in [0, 1].
tracking_quality.units: unitless flags, categorical code, and confidence values
